text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on May 20 and 21, 2026. May 20, 2026 Councillor Pasternak, during the morning session of the meeting, welcomed members of the Grandravine Tornadoes Special Hockey team and organizer Michael Liotta from Grandravine Special Hockey who were present in the Council Chamber. Councillor Pasternak advised Members of Council that Grandravine Special Hockey hosted the Special Hockey International Tournament this past March 5 to 7, 2026. Councillor Morley, during the morning session of the meeting, advised Members of Council about the retirement this week of Jasmine Dooh, a health promoter in Etobicoke--Lakeshore, and gave remarks about Jasmine’s legacy.
